gates.title: Verified Keyverse identity and tenant-scoped authorization
required_evidence: Exact issuer, audience, token-type, signature, time, client, role, scope, and purpose validation.
Tenant isolation and action authorization on every protected read and mutation.
Production deployment cannot enable an unauthenticated remote-preview path.
Cross-tenant, forged-token, key-rotation, and service-principal regressions pass on the exact release head.
blockers: Issue #4 remains open.
Stacked PRs #5, #6, and #7 have not all merged into develop.
Tenant persistence/isolation and complete protected-read authorization are not implemented.
evidence: PR #5 defines the closed RFC 9068 Keyverse access-token verifier.
PR #6 defines bounded OIDC Discovery and JWKS loading.
PR #7 begins verified-principal enforcement on protected mutations.

gates.title: Production PostgreSQL schema and runtime lifecycle
required_evidence: Supported PostgreSQL driver and major-version matrix are hash-locked and documented.
Single-writer versioned migrations support clean install and every released upgrade path.
Application startup refuses missing, older, or newer unsupported schemas.
PostgreSQL CI proves trigger parity, concurrency, timeout, and restart behavior.
blockers: Issue #8 is open.
No supported PostgreSQL DBAPI dependency or PostgreSQL integration lane exists.
Application startup still owns create_all and migration DDL.

gates.title: Evidence key lifecycle, retention, legal hold, and recovery
required_evidence: Versioned envelope/keyring encryption supports bounded rotation and revocation.
Retention, disposition, and legal-hold decisions are tenant-scoped and audited.
Purpose-specific views omit unrelated fields without altering authoritative evidence.
Backup, point-in-time restore, and integrity verification meet declared RPO/RTO.
blockers: Issue #9 is open.
Ciphertext has no key version or cryptographic context.
Retention, legal hold, restore verification, and recovery objectives are undefined.

gates.title: Hardened signed artifact and protected release flow
required_evidence: A minimal non-root OCI image is built from pinned inputs and promoted by digest.
The artifact has verified SBOM, provenance, signature, and central security results.
Develop and release tags require exact checks and independent review without bypass.
Install, upgrade, rollback, and artifact revocation are rehearsed.
blockers: Issue #10 is open.
No container artifact, SBOM, provenance, signature, or release workflow exists.
Required status checks are not enforced on develop.

gates.title: Truthful probes, telemetry, SLOs, and incident operations
required_evidence: Liveness, readiness, and startup probes are distinct, bounded, and non-sensitive.
Graceful drain preserves transaction and audit semantics.
Structured logs, traces, and metrics correlate failures without secrets or plaintext evidence.
SLOs, alerts, dashboards, and rehearsed incident runbooks cover critical dependencies.
blockers: Issue #11 is open.
The current health endpoint is a constant liveness payload only.
No telemetry, SLO, alert, drain, or incident-runbook contract exists.

gates.title: Versioned bounded and replay-safe production API
required_evidence: Stable versioned request/response schemas reject unknown or ambiguous input.
Cursor pagination, idempotency, and optimistic HTTP preconditions are specified and tested.
RFC 9457 errors and resource/time/rate bounds fail safely without cross-tenant leakage.
OpenAPI documents authorization, compatibility, field selection, and deprecation.
blockers: Issue #12 is open.
Routes are unversioned and accept broad dictionary payloads.
Collections, retries, errors, payloads, and execution are not production-bounded.

gates.title: Risk register, assessments, treatment, and acceptance
required_evidence: Tenant-scoped risk records use versioned deterministic assessment methods.
Inherent and residual assessments preserve immutable rationale and evidence lineage.
Treatment, acceptance authority, expiry, review, and escalation are enforced.
Control effectiveness links existing official controls and evidence without duplication.
blockers: Issue #13 is open.
No risk register, assessment, treatment, acceptance, or review model exists.

gates.title: Audit programs, findings, remediation, retest, and closure
required_evidence: Audit programs and engagements preserve scope, criteria, roles, independence, and period.
Sampling, workpapers, and custody reference the existing evidence store.
Findings and corrective actions retain immutable history, due dates, and escalation.
Independent retest or governed risk acceptance is required before closure.
blockers: Issue #14 is open.
The append-only audit_event log is not an audit-program or finding workflow.

gates.title: Machine-verifiable production-readiness evidence contract
required_evidence: A versioned repository-owned manifest names every production gate and canonical issue.
A deterministic validator rejects malformed and internally inconsistent evidence.
Ordinary CI validates structure while release mode fails closed until all gates are ready.
Statement and branch coverage prove every validator decision path.
